questions.question: When the crowd found Jesus across the sea, what did He say was the reason they were looking for Him?

answers.text: They had eaten the loaves and had their fill
They had seen Him walking on the sea
They wanted Him to heal their sick

questions.question: When a crowd asked Jesus what they must do to perform the works of God, what did He say the work of God is?

answers.text: To believe in the One He has sent
To keep every command of the law
To give to everyone in need
